release_notes_summary: Stable 0.9.10 removes case tracking while preserving calculator workflows and archived case files on disk.
notes: Removes case tracking: the main-window case header, New Case, Save Case and Load Case controls, the vehicle association ledger, and mirror-backup integration are no longer available.
Existing case files and backup folders are not deleted, but this version no longer opens or saves case files. Keep a prior portable version if you need to work with archived case files.
Calculators and their in-memory panel state, manual vehicle weights and added loads, exports, settings, reference library lookups, and direct vehicle-data prefill remain available.

No calculation formulas or numerical behavior changed in this release. Existing method safeguards remain, including the off-axis method marked "Experimental - physical validation pending; not qualified for casework use."
The public package retains the 0.9.9 reference allowlist and exact approved reference bytes; internal-only materials remain excluded.

Full suite result for this source: 1,503 passed, 5 failed, 5 skipped. The five failures were guidance, saved-case wording, and stale-path audit assertions; those were corrected without changing calculation behavior.
The affected final follow-up group passed 95 tests. The full suite was not rerun after those follow-up corrections. Five optional PDF inspections were skipped.
The case-free local candidate passed official packaged startup smoke and compiled checks for absence of case persistence modules, CaseFile model references, and case controls.

The stable rebuild changes only version/channel/build metadata and stable updater configuration relative to the exact tested local source snapshot. Compiled app modules match the tested local candidate except build metadata.
